title: BUTTERFLIES AND ALL THINGS SWEET : THE STORY OF MS B'S CAKES
author: Gokson, Bonnae
summary: Bonnae Gokson's book Butterflies and All Things Sweet opens a window into the inspiration and ideas behind her extraordinary cake designs. Unique in the world, these cakes encapsulate the creative vision of the woman who made her name working with luxury brands including Chanel, Giorgio Armani, W Hotels and Ritz Carlton. Butterflies and All Things Sweet is not a cookbook, but a visual feast, exploring the ingredients, ideas and inspiration behind the works of edible art through lush photography shot on location in Hong Kong -- the home of Bonnae Gokson's cafes and restaurants -- and internationally. Includes artwork by the Chinese artist Qian Gang, the British artist Sir Peter Blake and the fashion illustrator Gladys Perint Palmer. The book aesthetically blends Bonnae Gokson's fashion experience with her culinary achievements, incorporating photography and haute couture fashion. Throughout her career, she worked with the world's best couturiers, architects, designers and stylists. This experience has helped develop her eye for contemporary trends and and her instinct for achieving the mix of fashion, music, food, art and travel that is the essence of today's global culture. She is known as an international lifestyle guru.

summary: This is a field report based on oral history, synthesizing the interviews of several personalities to reconstruct their historical memories of the temple in Chin Chun Foo, as well as the meetings of their religious life in the disappeared “Hokkien Village” in Kuala Lumpur, where they lived in the last century. The overall content of this book describes how a temple, from scratch, originated in the local social life of a village, and how it was integrated into the public life of the villagers, and how it continues to carry traditional cultural elements and values through the propagation of beliefs and customs. The history of Jinchunfu provides a typical example of the origins and evolution of fair temple rituals and beliefs in the villages and towns of Southern Fujian in the Nanyang region.
